# VLink Inc (vlinkinfo.com) — Research Findings

Method note: WebSearch/WebFetch were not available in this session (no such tool loaded), and most search engines (DuckDuckGo, Brave, Startpage, Mojeek, Google) blocked automated requests. I worked around this with direct `curl` fetches of vlinkinfo.com, LinkedIn's public company page, and — most productively — **Bing News RSS** (`bing.com/news/search?q=...&format=rss`), which honored queries and surfaced VLink's EIN Presswire releases. Full-text press releases were pulled directly from `einpresswire.com/article/<id>`. Confidence levels are noted per item. No files were written.

## 1. HQ and office locations

**Confirmed — HQ is South Windsor, Connecticut (not Glastonbury).**
- Contact page: "(HQ) +1 (860) 247-1400", HQ email `info.us@vlinkinfo.com` — https://vlinkinfo.com/about-us/contact-us (high confidence)
- Locations page verbatim: "Connecticut — 701 John Fitch Blvd, South Windsor, CT 06074, United States" and "Massachusetts — 233 Cochituate Rd #2, Framingham, MA 01701, United States" — https://vlinkinfo.com/locations (high confidence)
- About page: "From our headquarters outside Hartford, CT, USA, to our global hubs in India, Indonesia and elsewhere..." (high confidence)
- The Oct 2024 press release calls VLink "a South Windsor, CT-based leader," and the Sep 2025 release says "Headquartered in South Windsor, CT, with global offices in India, Canada, and Indonesia." (high confidence)

**US offices verified: South Windsor, CT and Framingham, MA. That is all.**
- I searched the entire vlinkinfo.com sitemap for "Dallas/Texas/DFW/Irving/Plano/Frisco/Austin/Houston" — **zero matches.** (high confidence)
- **Glastonbury, CT: no evidence found.** Your recollection does not match any current VLink address; the CT address is South Windsor. (medium-high confidence it's incorrect; low confidence on whether an older Glastonbury address ever existed)

**International offices (from press releases + locations page):**
- India: Gurugram and Noida ("Global Delivery Centers"), plus a third office in **Bengaluru** opened Oct 2024
- Canada: **Mississauga, Ontario** opened Oct 2024
- Indonesia; Singapore; and the site lists Canada as a region. Release also mentions plans to "potentially open offices in Serbia and London."
- Source: https://www.einpresswire.com/article/750982723 (Oct 14, 2024) (high confidence)

**Dallas / DFW association: NOT CONFIRMED.** No office, address, press release, or news item ties VLink to Dallas/DFW. Bing News query "VLink Inc Dallas OR Texas OR DFW" returned zero results. The only DFW angle in this whole picture is the Microsoft-hosted golf event itself. Note also that Tony Dillon's phone number on the Microsoft press release is **+1 773-398-0061 — a Chicago (773) area code, not Dallas.**

## 2. Company size

Headcount figures are inconsistent across VLink's own pages (self-reported, so treat as approximate):
- About page: "more than 800 software experts"; stat block "800+ Agile enabled employees" — https://vlinkinfo.com/about-us
- Microsoft Business Solutions page: "850+ certified professionals" and "650+ Microsoft-certified consultants" (licensing page) — https://vlinkinfo.com/services/microsoft-business-solutions
- Homepage: "over 650 pre-vetted engineers" — https://vlinkinfo.com/
- **LinkedIn company page: 644 employees, 251,215 followers** — https://www.linkedin.com/company/vlink-inc (medium-high confidence; a third-party count)
- Client/experience claims: "20+ Years of Experience, 10+ Countries served, 05+ Worldwide offices, 400+ Projects Delivered, 200+ Global Clients, 98% Customer Satisfaction" (about page); LinkedIn says "300+ global clients." These conflict (200 vs. 250 vs. 300+ clients) — all self-reported.
- **Revenue: not public; no reliable figure found.** Paywalled/JS-blocked sources (ZoomInfo, Growjo, Crunchbase, D&B, Buzzfile) could not be retrieved. (low confidence / unknown)

## 3. Founding, founders, ownership

- **Founded 2006** — stated verbatim in the Oct 2024 press release ("Founded in 2006, VLink delivers cutting-edge IT solutions..."). Note the careers page separately says "16+ Years of Service," consistent with ~2006-2008. (medium-high confidence, self-reported)
- **Founder name: NOT confirmed.** No source identified a founder/founders. (low confidence)
- **CEO/President: Sharad Patney** (leadership page and multiple press releases). (high confidence)
- **Ownership: privately held. Described as a "proud Minority owned business"** and "a minority supplier for the Greater New England area, the Capital Region, the PA Department of General Services, & the Supplier Diversity office of the Commonwealth of MA. VLink is MBE-certified by the NY & NJ Affiliate Council and the NYC Small Business Services Council. In addition, VLink is A+ rated by the BBB." — https://www.einpresswire.com/article/750982723 (high confidence on the claims as stated)
- Caution: A Dec 2005 Gulf News article about a Dubai online marketplace called "vLink" (CEO Kombiz Eghdami) is a **different company** — do not conflate. (high confidence)

## 4. Microsoft partnership

- **Microsoft Solutions Partner for Digital & App Innovation (Azure)** — announced Sep 17, 2025. Verbatim from the release: "VLink Inc., a global technology solutions provider, is proud to announce it has been recognized as a Microsoft Solutions Partner for Digital & App Innovation (Azure)." Quote attributed to **Tony Dillon, AVP of Solution Sales & Partnerships at VLink**. https://www.einpresswire.com/article/849587564 (high confidence)
- **LinkedIn company description (verbatim): "Microsoft Solutions Partner – Data & AI | Digital & App Innovation"** — i.e., they claim **two** Solutions Partner designations. https://www.linkedin.com/company/vlink-inc (medium-high confidence; self-reported on the official company page, no separate press release found for the Data & AI designation)
- **Azure Expert MSP** — the Microsoft Business Solutions page states: "VLink is a Microsoft Solutions Partner and Azure Expert MSP" and "As a trusted Microsoft Alliance Partner and Azure Expert MSP, VLink adheres to the highest standards of Microsoft's Cloud Partner Program." https://vlinkinfo.com/services/microsoft-business-solutions (medium confidence — vendor claim; I could not independently verify an Azure Expert MSP credential in Microsoft's directory, which is JS-gated)
- **Authorized Microsoft licensing partner** — "VLink is an authorized Microsoft licensing partner..." https://vlinkinfo.com/services/microsoft-licensing-partner (medium confidence, vendor claim)
- Competency/solution coverage claimed: Azure (Cloud Transformation), Data & AI (Power BI, Azure Synapse), Power Platform, Microsoft 365/Teams/Viva, Security & Compliance (Defender, Purview, Entra ID, Intune), Copilot, Licensing. (medium confidence)
- **No evidence of Microsoft Partner of the Year.** No "Gold Competency" language found (that legacy program was replaced by Solutions Partner designations). I did not find VLink in any Microsoft Partner of the Year announcement. (medium confidence on absence)

## 5. Services / offerings

From the site nav and pages:
- IT staffing / global tech talent (onshore, offshore, nearshore; "48-hour turnaround" claim)
- Software / digital engineering, custom software, mobile app development
- Cloud (Microsoft Azure migration, hybrid, managed services — "Azure Managed Services... When You Need an MSP")
- Data & AI (Azure AI/ML, Power BI, Synapse, predictive analytics, Copilot)
- Microsoft licensing & optimization
- Cybersecurity & compliance (Defender, Zero Trust, MXDR/SOC)
- Power Platform low-code apps/automation
- Power/legacy modernization (case study: IBM BAW + IBM FileNet upgrade); software testing (their "TestQuest" team); podcast/thought leadership ("Tech Talk with VLink")
- **Not found:** any explicit SAP or ServiceNow practice. (medium confidence they may not lead with those)

## 6. Press / news / event sponsorships (incl. golf)

- **Golf:** VLink sponsored the **2017 Travelers Championship** (PGA TOUR), June 19-25, 2017, at TPC River Highlands, **Cromwell, Connecticut** — "Michelob Ultra 19th Hole Sponsor Club on the 18th hole"; framed around charity (proceeds to Greater Hartford Community Foundation). https://vlinkinfo.com/resources/newsroom/vlink-sponsor-the-2017-travelers-championship (high confidence, but this is a 2017 Connecticut charity/PGA event, **not** a Microsoft event and **not** Dallas)
- **No VLink press release, sponsorship, or news item tied to a Microsoft event or to any Dallas/Texas golf or charity event was found.** (medium confidence on absence)
- Full EIN Presswire newsroom for VLink: https://www.einpresswire.com/newsroom/vlink-inc/

## 7. Recent news / awards / leadership (2024-2026)

- **Oct 14, 2024** — "VLink Inc. Accelerates Global Expansion with New Offices in India and Canada" (Bengaluru, Mississauga; plans for Serbia/London). Contact: Tracy Gardner, +1 615-477-4146. https://www.einpresswire.com/article/750982723
- **~Mar 2024** — Named a 2024 "Great Employers in Connecticut" (Best Companies Group). https://www.einpresswire.com/article/682475539
- **Dec 2024** — BBB Serving Connecticut "2024 Community Care Award," accepted at a Dec 2024 BBB ceremony. https://www.einpresswire.com/article/788032195
- **2025** — "2025 Incredible Workplace" recognition. https://www.einpresswire.com/article/829097585
- **Sep 16-17, 2025** — Microsoft Solutions Partner for Digital & App Innovation (Azure). https://www.einpresswire.com/article/849587564
- **2025** — AVA Digital Gold Award (2nd consecutive year) for "Tech Talk with VLink" podcast; host Tracy Gardner (Global Marketing Director). https://www.einpresswire.com/article/824852186
- **~Jan 7, 2026** — Podcast earned two Gold MarCom and two Gold AVA Digital Awards for 2025 (plus a MarCom Honorable Mention). https://www.einpresswire.com/article/880848963
- **~Feb 27, 2026** — Great Place to Work Certified for the **third** consecutive year. https://www.einpresswire.com/article/896157176
- **Leadership page (current):** Sharad Patney (President & CEO), Tracy Gardner (Global CMO), **Tony Dillon (AVP – Partnership Alliance)**, Sandeep Panchal (VP Enterprise Business), Sambhavi Gopalakrishnan (VP Strategy), Jitender Sachdeva (VP Technology), plus APAC/delivery leads; advisors Jagdish Dalal and Carl R. Johnson (CPA). https://vlinkinfo.com/about-us/leadership (high confidence)
- **Tony Dillon detail:** Title appears as "AVP – Partnership Alliance" on the leadership page and as "AVP Solution Sales & Partnerships" in the Sep 2025 Microsoft release, where he is the media contact (+1 773-398-0061). No dedicated bio page exists on the site (the `/about-us/team/tony-dillon` URL 404s). (high confidence)
- Note: `law.com` surfaced a litigation matter "VLink, Inc. v. Praxis Consultants Inc." — not investigated for relevance. (low relevance)

## Bottom line for the golf-event context

- VLink is a **South Windsor, Connecticut** company (Hartford area), not Glastonbury. It has **no verifiable Dallas/Texas/DFW office** — the DFW association is **inferred only** from Tony Dillon attending a Microsoft-hosted Dallas golf event, and is **not confirmed** by any public source. His listed contact number is a Chicago area code.
- VLink is a genuine **Microsoft partner** — a **Microsoft Solutions Partner for Digital & App Innovation (Azure)** (Sep 2025) and, per its LinkedIn page, also **Data & AI**. It markets itself as an **Azure Expert MSP** (unverified against Microsoft's directory) and an authorized **Microsoft licensing partner**. No Partner of the Year status found.
- The only golf connection on record is the **2017 Travelers Championship (Cromwell, CT)**, a Connecticut charity/PGA event — nothing linking VLink to Microsoft or Dallas golf.

**Least certain items:** founder identity (unknown), revenue (unknown), the "Azure Expert MSP" and "Data & AI Solutions Partner" credentials (company-asserted, not independently verifiable here), and exact headcount (company figures range 644 LinkedIn to 850+ claimed).
